title: Séjour mitigé
text:
+ Hôtel correct pour une courte étape près de Sanatoga, mais expérience assez mitigée.

Points positifs : chambres spacieuses, parking gratuit et emplacement pratique si vous avez besoin d’être dans le secteur. Le petit-déjeuner est inclus et propose quelques options chaudes, ce qui est appréciable.

- En revanche, la qualité est très irrégulière. La propreté laisse parfois à désirer (odeurs, état des draps ou de la salle de bain selon les chambres) et l’entretien général pourrait être amélioré. L’hôtel est aussi assez bruyant à cause de la proximité de la route.

Lors de mon séjour, j’ai eu un gros problème de bruit dès la première nuit : j’ai été réveillé par deux personnes en train de se battre dans le couloir. Il y avait aussi des gens qui fumaient à l’entrée de l’hôtel, ce qui donne une mauvaise impression générale et un sentiment d’insécurité.

Globalement, ça peut dépanner pour une nuit à petit budget, mais je ne le recommanderais pas pour un séjour prolongé ou si vous cherchez du confort et une expérience vraiment agréable.

text:
+ Not much.  It was a awful experience

- To start with I am disabled.  It started when we checked in.  I had asked in advance for a bathtub and a room on the first floor days before we arrived.   When I checked in they said there were no rooms left on the first floor but had one on the second floor.  They told me all their rooms had bathtubs.  That was not true as when we got settled and looked, there was no tub.  When I tried to use the phone to call the desk, the phone was dead.  There was only one luggage rack that was already in use.  We waited but none became available.  We found out they only have one.  My partner had to hand carry all our baggage without a cart to the second floor.  There was no directory of the TV channels either on the tv or a card of them.  My partner had to walk down to the main desk and tell them of the problems.  After awhile, a man came up and fixed the phone and tv, which still did not work correctly while we were there.  Later on the toilet stopped up and my partner went down, got a plunger and had to plunge the toilet himself.  But that is not the end.  The next day when we came back for a funeral, our electronic key did not work.  I had to go down to the desk and no one was there.  They finally came after about 10 minutes and told me if you pay by credit card for more than two days, we lock the key after one day and you have to come down to have it fixed.  These people have not idea how to run a hotel.  You check rooms BEFORE you give them to people.  You do what they ask and tell the truth.  This was an awful experience.  It would be difficult for an average person, but being disabled, it becomes a disaster.  Never ever will go to there again.

title: Trip Back, last one
text:
+ The King Bed Room was on the ground floor and it was spacious. The empty space could have fit another King sized bed. Which was perfect for our 2 dogs traveling with us, plenty of room to lay around and play. 
At the front desk, Matt, was very pleasant and polite! And Maggie, she was cleaning and preparing rooms, but seemed to also be in charge of maintenance, was very friendly, approachable, personable and just overall a very pleasant woman, which shocked me a bit based on previous experiences with "housekeeping" at other motels in the past. I know when I cleaned rooms 35 years ago I wasn't at all happy to have guests bothering me while I was trying to get my rooms done. THANK YOU, MAGGIE!!! YOUR DISPOSITION & DEMEANOR IS TRULY APPRECIATED HERE!!

- Our door key would only allow 1 key card to be assigned to our room, I believe this is in the process of being updated.
The only bed in the room, which had an empty space that would fit another King or 2 Queens with 3 side tables, was too close to the wall on one side. No room to walk along that side and definitely no room for a nightstand. The headboard is attached to the wall, so I guess instead of repositioning that, aligning the King bed was the chosen option. There should be enough space to access both sides of a King Bed comfortably.
The shower head would not spray the water out, it flowed like a hose with your finger just over the opening. I thought it to be clogged, when I tried to adjust the spray the head itself I screwed from its connector and the o-ring inside popped out in 3 pieces. I checked the holes and they were all clear so I figured the broken o-ring was causing the poor spray. Without adding another o-ring I got the head back on and it was still flowing the same. So, with the faulty shower head, our showers were more like a stand up bath with cups. As we were checking out, I did inform the woman going room to room and she asked if I let the front know, I did not, which I should have, she said because she would have replaced it for our stay.
The following rant is for everyone. COMMON COURTESY When at a motel or hotel or even apartment buildings, please THINK before you act about how you would feel if you were someone else. Then adjust yourself before you back your oversized truck into a spot so you don't have your bumper hovering over ½ the already small walkway & in front of room doors, they may not be able to get around as easily as you!! Before backing in like that take not to the structure pillars and notice the obvious repairs from its past because of morons trying to fit where they ought not be!!

title: This room is not handicap acces. Broken door, no service
text:
+ Friendly staff. breakfast service was good. We look forward to trying other choice hotel places.

- There were issues with our room from the onset of our stay. 
This room is in no way a handicap accessible room.  Bed way to high (Hip high), not properly set up for a wheel chair user. Not enough room in the bath room. 
Issues with the room. 
The room is very tired.  Desk chair has rips on it. All the furniture in the room is worn. Just need replacing. 
The dresser drawers were dirty, we were not able to use the dresser. We were there for 3 days. It would have been nice not to live out of suitcases.
The bathroom door broke upon our arrival.  Was not fixed till our next night after 5 pm.  (We had book 2 additional nights using Booking.com) This particular room has pocket doors. One side of the door does not work unless you are able to use to hands. In order to put the door in the open position, you needed two hand and a foot to push it.  How is this accessible? The attempt was made to fix the door, making the opening even smaller than before.  Less than three feet wide. Is this Handicap accessible?  Also the repair did leave sawdust on the floor. I know maintenance person attempted to clean up. But housekeeping should have been called. 
Upon trying to use the shower, I almost fell.  There was no rubber shower mat provided for standing on.  The shower was walk in, but it is all tile. Extremely slippery. I also went to use the shower chair that was provided, and it was not safe as one of the legs were bent.  I went to the front desk to see if there was a matt available or possible a different chair. 
I was instructed to put a towel on the floor of the shower.  I did as was instructed, it ended up flooding the bathroom into the hallway of the room. (NOT SAFE). Ended up using towels provided to clean up the water ourselves. We ended up purchasing a rubber bathmat ourselves so that we could use the shower.  (NOT GOOD)  The staff did provide a new shower chair. 
During our three day stay, there was no daily service provided, trash emptied or bed made.

text:

- I was assigned to a room that was in use, although the occupants were not in it at the time, however all their property was still in the room. As a result I was downgraded from a King to a 2-doubles room. What if the occupants had been in the room and were armed? This could have ended extremely badly and there is NO excuse for this to have happened. 

The corridor lighting is so bright outside the room that the room never gets truly dark. They need to revamp the light dampening drastically! The hotel is badly run down and in need of a full refresh. For $50/night I wouldn't complain. For $95/night that's just plain unacceptable.

title: Unpleasant, damp and smelly room
text:
+ Nothing

- We had booked two separate rooms for three people and specifically requested a ground floor room with a walk-in shower for a friend with a disability. The booking photos showed walk-in showers, which gave us the clear impression this would be included. However, upon arrival, we were told no such room had been reserved, and the hotel was very full for the night.

The receptionist offered whatever ground floor rooms were still available, and we spent over 30 minutes walking back and forth between reception and different rooms, trying to find one that was  remotely accessible. One room reeked of cigarette smoke, another room’s light was already lit when we entered and was extremely damp, with no walk-in shower.

We eventually settled on a room that did have a walk-in shower, but it was still unacceptable — there were no proper bedsheets, just a bare comforter on the mattress. The room felt neglected and unhygienic.

The second room we had, located on the top floor, was slightly better in appearance but also damp. By morning, the floor was wet from condensation, and the entire room smelled musty. None of us got proper rest.

Overall, the experience was frustrating and disappointing. The photos were highly misleading — the rooms looked far better online than in real life. For a rate of $85 per night, this was far from budget and absolutely not worth the price. We would not recommend staying here.

title: A disaster!
text:
- We booked a 3-night stay beginning on Friday, August 30.  When we arrived we noticed an extremely strong smell of cleaning products in the lobby and common areas. The smell was so strong that our traveling companion’s eyes watered whenever she had to pass through those areas. Also, hallways outside the rooms were not clean. There were stains and debris on the carpets. There was only one elevator working and many of the buttons didn’t light up. We had booked a king room and the room we were given smelled so strongly of bleach that I got an immediate headache. There was no closet in the room and the area where there was supposed to be a wardrobe was empty - absolutely no place to hang clothes. When we went to the front desk to get the problem resolved, there was a line of people complaining and asking for different rooms. One person was complaining about their room flooding. By the time our issue was addressed, there were no king rooms available so we had to take a double queen.
At first, it seemed that the room was fine - no strong smell and it had a closet. The next morning we learned that was not the case when water started dripping, then pouring out of the fan/light fixture in the bathroom. This was directly over the toilet. Lucky for us, we had just finished getting ready to go out for the day. We were told the room above us had a clog and was flooding. But there were no more rooms available so they told us they would fix the problem.
When we returned late afternoon, they were still working on stopping the water flow. When they finally got the water to stop, we spent the rest of the trip dealing with the strong smell of wet plaster. We stayed calm throughout our ordeal. We were told that the hotel had new management and they hadn’t had time to fix all the issues because it was still busy season. They offered us an apology and told us they would credit us for one night of our stay. We accepted the offer.
A quick word about the breakfasts they served.

title: 4 day Visit
text: This hotel has good location and was value for the money it cost the room whilst tired and dated was very adequate. It was large and had fridge and microwave. The breakfast was hot buffet with plenty of selection to suit most people. The staff on reception were very helpful. The surroundings to the hotel are attractive and its easy to find with good parking. I would stay again for low cost convenient hotel.

title: Wonderful stay...
text: This was our first time in Strasburg-Lancaster. We had no information about hotels other than what we could find on the internet! We selected the Clarion Inn because it was very close to Sight and Sound theater, we intended to see their production of Joseph - it was great! We could not have been more please! The staff went out of their way to serve their guests. The rooms (at least ours) were very clean. Breakfast was included with the room and was excellent, including eggs, sausage, waffles, and many more items. We would definitely choose to stay at the Clarion Inn again!
